16.6   Acquisition of Subsidiary and Goodwill
On 1 November 2025, JAT Exports DMCC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Group, acquired 100% of the issued share capital of
Mirotone (NZ) Limited, thereby obtaining control over its operations. Further, on 25 June 2025, JAT Holdings PLC incorporated
Volt Industrial Company (Private) Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Group. Accordingly, the financial results, assets and
liabilities of Mirotone (NZ) Limited and Volt Industrial Company (Private) Limited have been consolidated into the Group financial
statements from their respective dates of acquisition/incorporation in accordance with applicable SLFRSs.
